title: Birthday Budget Entry Weekly Days Until Birthday Trend
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birthday:budget days_until_birthday=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_until_birthday) as avg_duration, max(days_until_birthday) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days until birthday for birthday budget entry events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_until_birthday on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days until birthday with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether birthday budget entry tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
